what_this_is: The practice tool: cards that come back on a spaced repetition schedule until they stick (src/practice.mjs, run in the person's account).

payload.label: Practise until it sticks
payload.job: Keep something a person wants to get right every time (a word to use instead of another, a habit, a fact, a correction they keep giving) as a practice card that comes back on a spaced repetition schedule until it sticks, and remind them each day when cards are due
payload.description: operation add: { prompt, answer, why?, deck?, source_ref?, time_zone? } keeps a card (adding the same prompt again keeps its progress) and, with time_zone, sets one daily reminder. due: { deck?, limit? } lists the cards due now. grade: { card_id, grade: again | hard | good | easy } moves the card's next return out (1 day, 6 days, then longer) or, when missed, back to tomorrow, and says its mastery from 0 to 1000. cards: { deck? } lists every card with its mastery. remove: { card_id } stops it coming back. remind tells the person how many are due. Ask the person the prompt, let them answer in their own words, then grade it.

why.description: Why it matters, in their words

deck.description: A group of cards, such as a subject

source_ref.description: The message or file it came from

time_zone.description: The person's time zone, for the daily reminder (like America/Los_Angeles)

card_id.description: A card from due or cards
